entities.summary: Alastair David Kellock is Head of Performance Pathways at the SRU. He was previously the managing director at Glasgow Warriors. He is a former Scotland international rugby union player. He played as a lock for Edinburgh Rugby and Glasgow Warriors, captaining the Warriors to a Pro12 league win in 2015.
